review_notes: I read the whole file. I also checked the Mathlib sorting API: Finset.sort, List.toFinset_sort, and List.perm_insertionSort / List.pairwise_insertionSort. The definitions and lemmas are already generic over the codec type A, an arbitrary relation r with DecidableRel, and DecidableEq A. Lemmas that don't need the Codec instance are marked `omit [Codec A] in`. canonical_eq_sort carries the same IsTrans, Std.Total and Std.Antisymm assumptions that Finset.sort requires, so I found no useful weakening. The remaining statements (weight_perm, weight_orderedInsert, the fold lemmas, and the polynomial-time lemmas with their fixed bound polynomials) are already general in everything that matters, or are tied to the Realizer machinery. I did not find a justified specialisation that needs no new mathematics. The one limit is that I did not inspect the Realizer and weight infrastructure beyond a grep, so I cannot rule out a generalisation that depends on it.
